entities.summary: Charles Thomas Lefley was a Canadian professional ice hockey forward. He played in the National Hockey League with the Montreal Canadiens and St. Louis Blues from 1970 to 1980. With the Canadiens he won the Stanley Cup twice, in 1971 and 1973. Internationally he played for the Canadian national team at the 1969 World Championship.
